changelog:
• Zero-Lag Ultra-Smooth Camera Streaming: Decoupled socket reader and renderer with instant stale-frame dropping (<30ms latency)
• High FPS & Zero GC Jitter: RGB_565 decoding with reusable inBitmap memory, eliminating stuttering
• Smart AI Default: YOLOv8 AI defaults to OFF for maximum framerate, running async on toggle
• ESP32 Auto-Tuning: Quality 12 compression, 19.5 dBm Wi-Fi power, and disabled modem sleep
